test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

P + Q means ‘P is the father of Q’,

P # Q means ‘P is the mother of Q’,

P & Q means ‘P is the wife of Q’,

and P % Q means ‘P is the sister of Q’.

How is V related to D if ‘V % L & C + B % D’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b4fb2a6974b67ac1a6a020a53ab4eab78fe13ccabb1e43676b8a1c25085b3c1.png] 

We draw the following table from given conditions: 

 
 

 
 
P is

 
 
 

 
 
+

 
 
 
#

 
 
 
&

 
 
 
%

 
 
 

 
 
Father

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Wife

 
 
 
Sister

 
 
 

 
 
of Q

 
 
 

**
V % L & C + B % D → V is Sister of L, L is wife of C, C is father of B and B is sister of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/811137989c5bd5b4b78f2a97f723ede55374fad295e3b487aa43e8036872cbb9.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/312c9f78ac1fc5c5a1b2430cc14a81764dadc1be32d39dffdfd767103306422f.png] 

V is D's mother's Sister.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 4**”.
